nate: quick note  seeing repeated request ids in Node SDK logs when retries fire. seems to be an otel/context ordering issue.
priya: does this reproduce in sampleapp or only internal services?
nate: easily reproduced in sampleapp with axios-retry. snippet: 
```
2026-03-21T12:01:01Z INFO request_id=dupme start /v1/chat
2026-03-21T12:01:02Z WARN request_id=dupme retry
2026-03-21T12:01:02Z INFO request_id=dupme start /v1/chat
```
emma: that will confuse our redaction since we key off request_id tokens; also screws SLI counting.
priya: short fix: retry wrapper injects new x-request-id per attempt. medium: opt-in x-log-event-id per log line. long: adjust otel hook so retry attempts create isolated child spans.
nate: i've pushed a tiny sampleapp branch that injects x-request-id and logs x-log-event-id when enabled.
devex-bot: reminder: add CHANGELOG entry and open DE ticket for full otel parity.
